title: Source-first monetary discovery census: PHB and DMG

scope.purpose: A full PDF-page text-screening census plus bounded page/group-level visual discovery for the supplied PHB and DMG scans. It enumerates direct monetary-claim and monetary-table categories found in the visually screened pages beyond already named inventories.
scope.coverageClaim: The PDF page denominator is complete and every PDF page has a screening state. Semantic discovery is not whole-book complete: text-screened noncandidates are not evidence of absence; many candidates remain unreviewed; reduced contact-sheet review does not establish exact wording, row mapping, or table completeness.
scope.sourcePriority: Hash-verified private source PDF scans are authoritative. PyMuPDF text cues and OCR help queue pages but do not establish monetary meaning, wording, or absence.
scope.tablePolicy: New table categories are recorded at group level only. No new table group is row-transcribed in this census.
scope.privacy: Original PDFs, full-page renders, and the supplemental p.175 scan remain private and are not included in the repository artifact.

sources.printedPageRule: PDF pages 2-129 carry printed folios 1-128; PDF pages 1 and 130 are unnumbered/blank matter.
sources.sourceStorage: private verified original PDF; not copied into repository
sources.edition: not inferred beyond supplied title/scan identity

sources.printedPageRule: PDF pages 2-175 carry printed folios 1-174. Printed p.175 is missing from the PDF. PDF pages 176-238 carry their same-numbered printed folios 176-238. PDF p.239 is an unnumbered removable reference sheet; p.240 is blank.
sources.sourceStorage: private verified original PDF; not copied into repository
sources.edition: not inferred beyond supplied title/scan identity

screeningMethod.tool: PyMuPDF text extraction from every page; source PDF hashes and page counts checked before screening.
screeningMethod.candidateRule: A page is a screened-candidate if one or more configured cue regexes match extracted text. A screened-noncandidate means only that none of these cues matched the extracted text.
limitations: Image-only/empty text layers and OCR omissions can hide claims.
Broad cues intentionally overinclude weight/encumbrance, starting money, XP, treasure-generation quantities, gem descriptions, table-of-contents entries, and non-price uses of cost/value words.
A candidate is not a verified monetary claim.
A noncandidate is not a verified absence.
Contact-sheet thumbnails support only page/group classification; fine print, exact units, conditions and row/value pairings require source-scale review.

limitations: This is a monetary discovery census, not a source-row transcription or whole-book semantic completeness claim.
The 370-page denominator counts only the PHB and DMG PDFs. The separate DMG printed-p.175 image is a supplement and is excluded from that count.
Counts distinguish screened pages, visually screened thumbnails, and previously inventoried scoped pages; these are not interchangeable denominators.

Starting wealth, currency conversion, ordinary purchase prices, hireling wages, service fees, construction costs, spell/component costs, treasure generation, market valuations and item values are typed separately rather than treated as equivalent “prices.”
Any exact amount in discoverySummary or locatorAmountCue is a locator note only pending source-scale verification; it must not be consumed as a normalized/verified source fact.
